description.value: Barnacle Barney's Fish and Chips is a fish and chips restaurant situated on First Avenue in Ladysmith, a historic waterfront town on Vancouver Island. Located in a retail building in the town centre, it is likely a casual stop for hungry cyclists passing through on the E&N corridor or the Trans Canada Trail. The name and setting suggest a classic coastal takeout experience well suited to a mid-ride meal.
